subject: general
question: With which Indian state is the ‘Panthi’ dance form associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhattisgarh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Satnami community** in **Chhattisgarh **performs the **Panthi dance.**
 
• Music associated with dance conveys the** value of human existence** along with powerful **spiritual teachings**, with the main emphasis being on almighty devotion.
 
• The lyrics reflect the** renunciation of their gurus' teachings** and those of **Saints like Kabir, Ravidas, and Dadu.**
 
• **Saila Dance, Karma, Sua Nacha, Panthi Dance, Raut Nacha, Gendi, etc.** are other famous dances of Chattisgarh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **State**
 **Dance**
 
 

 Maharashtra
 Lavani, Koli Dance, Dhangari Gaja, Povadas Dance, Tamasha, Dindi, Kala.
 
 

 Punjab
 Bhangra, Giddha, Sammi, Kikli, Jhoomer, Jaago, Dankara or Gatka Dance.
 
 

 Kerala
 
 
 
 
 
 Mohiniyattam, Thiruvathirakali, Theyyam, Koodiyattam, Chakyar Koothu and Ottamthullal.
